description.value: Dockside F&C is a fish and chips restaurant located in Haida Gwaii, one of British Columbia's most remote and dramatically beautiful cycling destinations, accessible only by ferry or floatplane. Operating seasonally, it offers a classic coastal meal to visitors exploring the islands. For touring cyclists making the journey to Haida Gwaii, a hot dockside fish supper is a memorable reward.
